## Look

Run the start hook against this repo and read what an agent now receives:

    printf '{"cwd":"/home/andrewyin/orchestra","session_id":"look"}' | uv run orchestra hook-start --claude | python3 -c "import json,sys; c=json.load(sys.stdin)['hookSpecificOutput']['additionalContext']; print(len(c)); print(c)"

Expect under 9,000 characters (was 16,643): the protocol, then active constraints from every live effort, then compact effort sections without id links, newest position first, then one "Not shown: …" line naming the efforts left out.

## Machine

- Acceptances: 15 active for phase hook-context-budget; each has a passing `orchestra check` run at b58320f64.
- Oracle-backed tdd acceptances: 11, frozen in tests/test_hooks.py (656488cb) and tests/test_hooks_dropped_groups.py (8f76e7ef); red at e6b7d1957 / 8d21b2808, green at descendants.
- Assessments: R1–R14 verified.
- Review: hook-context-budget-review fail at f40b355ed (three findings), fix task fix-hook-dropped-groups, re-review pass at b58320f64.
- Integration report: pass at b58320f64.
- Suite: hook-context-budget-suite (advisory, full) pass at b58320f64 (rec-d19132f1).
- Types: trial merge of main + phase/hook-context-budget, `uv run basedpyright`: 0 errors.

## Attention

- `orchestra review-brief` does not scope to a phase; it dumps every work-item in the store (~940KB). This phase built a scoped brief by hand from the same allowed inputs.
- For an effortless needs-human group, the "Not shown" line names item subjects; `orchestra handoff --effort <subject>` does not show those items.
- The budget loop stops at the first section that does not fit, so up to ~1,800 characters can stay unused when a large section (e.g. packaging) is next.
